environment.description: Invoice parsing microservice deployed on ECS Fargate in an isolated private subnet (no NAT gateway, no internet gateway attached to VPC). Service is exposed exclusively through a com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890 interface endpoint (AWS PrivateLink). The VPC endpoint policy restricts Principal to arn:aws:iam::987654321098:root (the single consuming account). The subnet route table contains only local VPC CIDR routes (10.0.48.0/20 -> local) with no 0.0.0.0/0 route. DNS resolution for the service is only available via the VPC endpoint's private DNS name. Security group on the ENIs backing the VPC endpoint allows inbound only from 10.0.0.0/16 on port 8080. The ECS task's security group allows outbound only to 10.0.48.0/20 (same subnet) on port 443 for ECR VPC endpoint pulls. No other outbound rules exist. VPC Flow Logs confirm zero packets to any public IP from the task ENI over 90 days.

config.network: isolated private subnet, no IGW, no NAT
config.dns: private hosted zone only, no public resolution
config.flow_logs: zero egress to public IPs over 90 days
